name: Stealthium
description: Access Stealthium Alerts, Metrics and Inventories in Claude to ensure you can correlate with other tools in your stack.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Stealthium to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Stealthium to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.stealthium.io/api/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Stealthium MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stealthium provides these MCP tools: get_alert, get_alert_summary, list_alerts, and list_scopes.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Stealthium?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Stealthium in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Stealthium requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Stealthium is developed by Stealthium, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
